posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
For International backers, there's also shipping involved to inflate the funding level.

My Obivaeon pledge was $239 ($139 level + $49 Foil Villain pack + $1 poster + $50 shipping).

My Season 2 pledge is $25 (Just the level).

 

I have considered the hero and villain packs for the digital game, but I decided they just don't appeal to me in the digital game.  I certainly want them for Tabletop as the foil cards will look great on the table.  I don't feel the same about the digital version.  In fact, even if I got the art packs, I'd have more desire to stick with the original art cards in the digital game, as I missed out on some of the original promos for my tabletop copy and thus I'll only ever be able to play with that art in the digital game.

 

So yeah, I really want to see the project do well and unlock more stretch goals, but none of the add-ons appeal to me, unfortunately…
